pages.title: Quartz Singularity
pages.text: Nether quartz crushed into one point, its crystal lattice compressed until it has no edges at all. It is milky white and faintly warm. Squeezing it seems to produce a tiny piezoelectric spark. Every vibration in the room seems to pass through it and come out sharper.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Quartz becomes electric when squeezed, so I squeezed as much as I could in the Singularity Compactor. The crystals collapsed together into a single, faintly charged point.
